summary: @servicetitan/mpa-components preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute the package-local file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte file whose body is a rotating string-array cipher (function WV8StW rotates an array of hundreds of hex-encoded tokens using push/shift) with hex-named identifiers — the standard javascript-obfuscator output shape. The package presents itself as a React component library, which does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime or a 728 KB obfuscated 'math_init' blob. The Bun download is not pinned to a hash or signature-verified, and the payload it runs is opaque to Node-based scanners because execution is routed through Bun rather than Node. Executing this obfuscated payload occurs automatically on npm install via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
